_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest), judged by eye from the figures. 1: the missing part is a plain copy of another part; 2: a part turned half round or flipped, with few lines; 3: a turned part with many lines, or lines to carry on into the gap; 4: a pattern of colours or shading to keep going round. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
